matrix_label: M5 Review-Request, Checks, and Merge-Queue Component Matrix

component_rows.scope_summary: Review-request row listing a provider-linked pull/merge request with provider identity, base/head relation, and freshness always explicit
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-authored title, author, and review state are labeled provider-backed; base/head and diff summary are local-computed and never presented as provider truth
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Opening the request on the provider host is an explicit browser handoff with a labeled return path to the local review workspace
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When provider state is stale the row keeps last-known provider fields labeled and lets local diff review continue offline

component_rows.scope_summary: Checks-summary card rolling up check-class truth and freshness without collapsing distinct check classes into one status pill
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-reported check verdicts are labeled provider-backed; locally re-run check results are labeled local and never merged silently into the provider roll-up
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Opening full check logs on the provider is an explicit browser handoff; ordinary triage stays in-product and never forces raw-provider navigation
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When provider check status is stale the card shows last-known verdicts labeled stale and offers local re-run to continue triage

component_rows.scope_summary: Pending-review tray listing reviews awaiting the current owner with owner identity and local-versus-provider origin always explicit
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-assigned review requests are labeled provider-backed; locally queued publish-later reviews are labeled local and never counted as provider-confirmed
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Opening a pending review on the provider is an explicit browser handoff with a labeled return path to the tray
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When provider assignment state is stale the tray keeps last-known items labeled stale and lets locally queued reviews continue offline

component_rows.scope_summary: Merge-readiness panel summarizing blocking state, required checks, and ownership; blocking reasons stay explicit rather than collapsed into a single ready/not-ready pill
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-enforced branch policy and required-check gates are labeled provider-backed; local merge-readiness estimate is labeled local and never presented as the provider's final gate
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Resolving a provider-enforced block on the host is an explicit browser handoff with a labeled return path to the panel
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When provider policy state is stale the panel shows last-known gates labeled stale and continues local readiness estimation without asserting provider approval

component_rows.scope_summary: Merge-queue entry with queue owner, position, and gating-check truth; provider-managed queue state is never flattened into a local estimate
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-managed queue position and owner are labeled provider-backed; local pre-merge estimate is labeled local and never presented as the queue's authoritative position
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Managing the queue entry on the provider is an explicit browser handoff with a labeled return path to the merge-queue panel
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When queue status is stale the entry shows last-known position and owner labeled stale and continues local review without asserting a fresh queue position

component_rows.scope_summary: Stack-dependency chip showing stack relation and parent-blocked state so a blocked stack parent is visible rather than hidden
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-reported stack relations are labeled provider-backed; locally derived stack topology is labeled local and never presented as the provider's confirmed stack order
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Opening a stack parent on the provider is an explicit browser handoff with a labeled return path to the stack view
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When provider stack state is stale the chip shows last-known relation labeled stale and continues local topology from change lineage

component_rows.scope_summary: Approval-invalidation banner naming why approvals were recomputed (stale base, new commits, policy change) rather than showing a generic warning pill
component_rows.provider_local_distinction: Provider-recomputed approval state is labeled provider-backed; local prediction that approvals will invalidate is labeled local and never asserted as the provider's decision
component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Re-requesting approval on the provider is an explicit browser handoff with a labeled return path to the review workspace
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: When provider approval state is stale the banner shows the last-known invalidation reason labeled stale and continues local review without asserting fresh approval
